issue.title: angular2 Only support at most 9 interpolation values!
issue.body:
**I'm submitting a ...**  (check one with "x")

```
[ ] bug report
```

**Current behavior**
When I am trying to interpolate more than 9 properties of an object in template I am getting the following error:
Error: Uncaught (in promise): Template parse errors:
Only support at most 9 interpolation values!

**Expected/desired behavior**
It should be able to print any number of properties of an object

**Reproduction of the problem**
The issue could be reproduced at : 
http://plnkr.co/edit/3M7lw6U4RAuOPacM4rmj?p=preview

**What is the expected behavior?**
It should be able to interpolate any number of properties of an object

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
I am unable to print all details details of users

**Please tell us about your environment:**
- **Angular version:** 2.0.0-rc4
- **Browser:** all 
- **Language:** Typescript

body:

IRW you would most certainly do `{{ lead|formatLead }}`

Without a pipe you can still do `{{ a + " " + b + ...}}`

issue.title: AOT fails when using more than 9 interpolation values with Pug
issue.body:
Compiling a project using the [pug template engine](https://pugjs.org) fails with the following error when there are more than 9 interpolation values:

```
C:\dev\aot-test>node_modules\.bin\ngc -p tsconfig-aot.json
Error: Template parse errors:
Error: Only support at most 9 interpolation values! ("[ERROR ->]h3 Home Component
p Welcome to Angular Seed
ul
"): HomeComponent@0:0
    at TemplateParser.parse (C:\dev\aot-test\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:7711:21)
    at OfflineCompiler._compileComponent (C:\dev\aot-test\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:13208:53)
    at C:\dev\aot-test\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:13152:109
    at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:103:7)
    at Function.Module.runMain (module.js:577:11)
    at startup (node.js:160:18)
    at node.js:456:3
Compilation failed
```

Note that unlike angular/angular#10253, these are **separate HTML elements**:

```pug
h3 Home Component
p Welcome to Angular Seed
ul
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }}
    li My variable: {{ foo }} (remove this line and it works)
```
You can reproduce it with [this fork of angular/angular2-seed](https://github.com/freezy/angular2-seed/tree/aot), which only adds AOT and replaces the home HTML template with a Pug template. Just run `./node_modules/.bin/ngc -p tsconfig-aot.json` and you should have it.

EDIT: Note that is works perfectly fine in the browser using `npm run server`.

body: We should just fix this as it is not hard. Please note that the issue regarding pug templates is different, i.e. the limitation only applies to interpolations in the same HTML text span.
